fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of Gross Sales, paid weekly via EFT (may be collected on a different interval). Brand Development Fund contribution is currently 2% of Gross Sales, paid weekly alongside royalty; franchisor may adjust subject to a Marketing Expenditure Cap. Regional/Local Advertising Co-Op contributions as determined by Co-Op (not currently charged). Local Advertising Requirement is the greater of $1,500 or 2% of prior month's Gross Sales, paid monthly. Initial Instructor Training Fee currently $200 per Instructor (may increase 10% annually). Teacher Training Program Fee is $4,995 per person ($2,100 to franchisor, $2,895 to Studio). Additional Training Fee up to $500/day per trainer if charged.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 8% of Gross Sales generated by your Studio over the relevant reporting period | Payable weekly via electronic funds transfer ("EFT") based on the Gross Sales of your Studio during the preceding business week | You will be required to start paying your Royalty once your Studio begins collecting revenue from operations. We may collect your Royalty on a different interval (for example, monthly).
Contributions to Brand Development Fund | Currently, 2% of Gross Sales | Payable weekly around the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | Your contributions (the "Fund Contributions") to the Brand Development Fund (the "Fund") will begin when your Studio begins generating revenue from operations. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required Fund Contributions, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap. See Note 3.
Regional or Local Advertising Co-Op | As the Co-Op determines (not currently charged) | As the Co-Op determines | We may establish regional cooperatives comprised of Studios that are within a given geographical area (each, a "Co-Op"). If a Co-Op is established where your Studio is located, you will be required to participate in that Co-Op and contribute to that Co-Op in the amounts the Co-Op determines. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required contributions to the Co-Op, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap. See Note 3.
Local Advertising Requirement | The greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales | Payable monthly with your 1st Royalty payment each month | This is a spending requirement, but we reserve the right to have you pay this amount to us rather than spending it yourself. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required spending, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap. See Note 3.
Initial Instructor Training Fee | Currently, $200 per Instructor | As incurred | You must have at least one (1) individual who meets the Instructor Eligibility Criteria and complete our Instructor Bridge Training Program. We may increase the Initial Instructor Training Fee by 10% annually.
Teacher Training Program Fee | $4,995 per person | Prior to training.
Training Fee | If charged, up to $500/day per trainer | Prior to training.
